subject.title: feat(control-ui): import Codex and Claude Code memory

question: Should `migrations.memory.plan` and `migrations.memory.apply` become permanent admin-scoped public Gateway APIs for discovering local coding-assistant memory and copying selected private files into agent workspaces?
rationale: This creates a privileged cross-product data and public protocol boundary; implementation quality cannot substitute for explicit owner intent about consent, authorization, and long-term API ownership.

options.title: Approve the bounded admin API
options.body: Keep the provider-neutral methods with explicit confirmation, redacted previews, workspace-bounded no-follow writes, backups, and complete native-client parity.

options.title: Narrow to an internal UI surface
options.body: Avoid a permanent public Gateway contract and keep the user flow behind a narrower Control UI-owned internal boundary.

options.title: Pause private-memory import
options.body: Defer the feature until the consent and protocol ownership model is redesigned.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded admin API
recommendation.body: Keep the provider-neutral methods with explicit confirmation, redacted previews, workspace-bounded no-follow writes, backups, and complete native-client parity.

likelyOwner.reason: They sponsor this feature and have the strongest adjacent merged history on Codex migration and recovery policy.
